snippet.title: Living is Expensive... Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4159050

---
Living is Expensive… is a short and funny visual novel about Vampires & Capitalism.
Defeat Primrose-sama's sleep deprivation monsters before they become real. 💤

Game Features:
- Working 9-5 
- Expensive Cost of Living
- Crushing weight of modern work on human psyche. 

---
Credits

Original music "Inflation" composed by Stethr1
https://twitter.com/TsuraiStethr1

Card design by KITTYPOOL
https://twitter.com/Kittypool7

Characters created with VRoid Studio
